title: Duo distro pack manifest — DISTRO.json (v1)
description: The Duo integration manifest for a distro pack's `duo-extras/` subtree (Stage 21d). IMPORTANT: identity fields (name, version, description, author, homepage) live in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, NOT here. This file declares only Duo-specific install behavior. Reference schema for authors + agents; intentionally lenient (extra fields are allowed so newer Duo versions can add behavior without invalidating older packs).

$comment.description: Free-form note; conventionally reminds authors that identity lives in plugin.json.

requiresDuoVersion.description: semver range the pack requires of the host Duo install, e.g. ">=0.8.0" or ">=0.6.7 <0.9.0". The installer refuses packs whose range excludes the running Duo version.

openOnFirstLaunch.description: Pack-relative canvas/file paths auto-opened the first time this pack@version is seen (keyed in installed-packs.json).

pinnedFiles.description: Pack-relative paths pinned in the working-pane tab strip on install.

claudeMdSnippet.description: When true, merge the pack's CLAUDE.md snippet into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md between distro-managed markers (re-runs on upgrade).

primingAdditions.description: When true, append the pack's priming additions to ~/.claude/duo/priming.md.

externalDomainsAdditions.description: When true, merge the pack's external-domain entries into ~/.claude/duo/external-domains.json (never clobbers an existing customized file).
